messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up to the admission RFC. Proposal: an emergency 'soft-cap' that triggers per-tenant+route during abuse spikes. Non-critical routes degrade first. Thoughts?
hiro: Good idea. Main risk: false positives. How detect spike?
sam: Combine signals: qps_ratio > 3x, 95th latency jump, abuse_score >= 0.7. All three to trigger.
maria: Telemetry must show which tenants/routes were softened and why.
elaine: Detector sketch: moving-window qps_ratio + ewma_latency + normalized abuse_score. Pseudocode: if qps_ratio>3 and ewma_latency>baseline*1.5 and abuse_score>=0.7 then trigger_soft_cap(tenant,route,reason="qps+latency+abuse")
hiro: What enforcement actions?
sam: Layered: 1) reduce non-critical route concurrency by 30%, 2) force cheaper model variant if available, 3) apply per-request token budget. Block only last resort.
maria: Add ttl (60s) and decaying backoff to avoid oscillation. Manual override required.
elaine: Ops: escalate if same tenant hit soft-cap 5x in 10m; retrospective logging.
hiro: Interface: detector and policy in admission-service, edge enforces quick rejects.
sam: Flow: detector -> admission-service (decision) -> edge (enforce).
maria: Telemetry: add trace tag soft_cap.reason, emit event to ops-alerts, dashboard per-tenant timelines.
elaine: Enforcement config example: {"soft_cap":{"concurrency_reduction_pct":"30","variant_fallback":"gpt-lite","token_budget":"1000","ttl_seconds":"60","escalate_if_reapplied":"5"}}
sam: Consider stepped reductions (30->50->80) if persistent.
hiro: Keep step state ephemeral in admission keyed by tenant+route with backoff counter.
maria: Ops playbook items: threshold mappings, dashboard guide, manual apply/lift steps, post-mortem template.
elaine: Action items: hiro prototype detector flags, sam draft enforcement API PR, maria mock dashboards, ops draft runbook.
hiro: I'll add a small loadtest to validate tail reduction.
sam: API idea: POST /v1/softcap/apply {tenant,route,config} and GET /v1/softcap/status?tenant=. Minimal.
maria: Tag events for replay: add trace_id and replayable=true.
elaine: Rollout: blue/green with 1% canary for 24h.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: admission-service/detector-proto -> canary (sha:abc123). :rocket:
elaine: Will keep thread updated with PR links and dashboard mocks.
